messages:
Lena (AE): FYI customer is ready to start a 6-week on-prem POC next week. They asked for 12-month commit pricing, but initial ask is POC license + platform fee waiver. Need deal desk guidance.
Marcus (SE): Who's the customer? Any special infra reqs?
Lena (AE): FinServ startup (US East). Must keep logs 90 days, KMS/HSM integration, and extended support (follow-the-sun, 24/7 oncall) for POC period.
Priya (Sales Eng): 90d retention is bigger than our default POC. Also they want per-cluster telemetry retained on-prem, which will increase storage/ops. Need an explicit SKU.
Omar (Finance): Platform fee waivers for POCs are ok up to 30 days. For 6-week POC + 12mo commit prospect, we can consider a one-time platform credit, not full waiver. Need numbers.
Jules (DealDesk): Put proposal: 6-week POC = waived platform fee up to $X, provided they sign LOI committing to minimum 6-month reserved capacity at EOY. Otherwise standard platform fee applies.
Marcus (SE): Technical blocker: customer requires isolated telemetry + audit logs exported to their SIEM. We can do S3 export + KMS. What's the extra engineering estimate?
Priya (Sales Eng): Rough calc: +2 FTE-weeks for packaging and docs, and baseline $2.5k/month storage ops per cluster during POC. Suggest we include a one-time engineering surcharge or amortize into platform fee credit.
Lena (AE): They also opened a security questionnaire; Security wants to see KMS/HSM lane and SOC2 attestations. SecurityBot, any red flags?
SecurityBot: SOC2 present. KMS integration requires client-provided key material for onprem - we support it via our KMS connector. HSM onprem is non-standard; needs SOW. Recommend we scope as professional services.
Jules (DealDesk): OK. Let's propose two options to AE: (A) POC credit of platform fee up to $10k + engineering time billed at cost, contingent on LOI for 6mo reserved capacity at 50% of expected production RPS; (B) No credit but include engineering as prepaid SOW and offer 10% discount on first year of reserved capacity. Which does the AE prefer?
Lena (AE): Customer prefers minimal upfront. They'd do LOI but not sign a financial commit until after POC. Option A sounds promising if we can lower the LOI commitment. Can we set LOI = "target commit" (non-binding) for approval path?
Omar (Finance): DealDesk needs a committed ARR threshold for approvals. We can approve credits if expected ARR > $150k ARR after conversion. If LOI non-binding, we need pre-approval from SVP Sales.
Jules (DealDesk): Will escalate to SVP. Meanwhile, can someone get a short cost estimate for the POC engineering & storage? Need numbers for the credit cap.
Priya (Sales Eng): I'll send an itemized estimate by EOD. Preliminary: Eng pack = $18k, storage ops $2.5k/mo x 1.5 months = $3.75k, total ~21.75k. Suggest $22k cap.
Lena (AE): Thanks. I'll flag to customer that a $22k platform/engineering credit is our starting point, conditional on LOI with target commit and a short SOW for KMS/HSM work.
Marcus (SE): For the SOW we should include runbook excerpt:
```
cluster:
  telemetry_retention_days: 90
  kms_mode: customer_provided
  siem_export: enabled
```
Priya (Sales Eng): Good. Also note we can offer a 24/7 support addon SKU for POC at $5k/mo — reduces engineering oncall risk.
Lena (AE): Customer prefers bundled support vs hourly. Ok will propose credit + 24/7 addon + LOI. Jules/Omar will wait for the estimate and escalation.
Jules (DealDesk): I'll prep a conditional approval template for SVP sign-off. Ping me when estimate is in.
Omar (Finance): +1. Also add clause: if conversion < threshold within 90 days of POC end, credits are recouped prorated.
Lena (AE): Noted. Thanks team. I'll loop back after Priya's estimate and customer confirmation. :thumbsup:
